_what: Batch 2 re-labelled under batch 3's conventions, to test whether batch 3's drop in v2's measured performance is a detector property or a labeller effect. Nineteen of the 80 were excluded as contaminated: this session had already seen their labels while diagnosing v2's errors. Agreement on the remaining 61 is 59/61 = 96.7%, Cohen's kappa 0.902, with identical base rates (13 true each). The two disagreements, F25 and F58, are both on the borderline class the rule's own _note names. Caveat: the excluded 19 are exactly where v2 erred, so this is an upper bound on inter-labeller agreement rather than a point estimate.
